entries.86.1: तदा then, नरश्रेष्ठः the best of men, सः that, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, वृत्रवधम् the slaying of Vritra, सर्वम् entire, अखिलेन without omission, कथयित्वा having related, कथाशेषम् the remainder of the tale, प्रचक्रमे set about
entries.86.2: ततः then, देवभयङ्करे terror of the gods, महावीर्ये of great might, वृत्रे when Vritra, हते was slain, ब्रह्महत्यावृतः beset by the slaying of a brahmin, वृत्रहा the slayer of Vritra, शक्रः Shakra, सञ्ज्ञाम् his senses, न लेभे recovered not
entries.86.3: सः he, लोकानाम् of the worlds, अन्तम् the end, आश्रित्य having taken refuge at, नष्टसञ्ज्ञः his senses lost, विचेतनः bereft of understanding, वेष्टमानः coiling, उरगः इव like a serpent, कञ्चित् some, कालम् time, तत्र there, अवसत् dwelt
entries.86.4: अथ then, सहस्राक्षे when the thousand-eyed one, नष्टे was lost, जगत् the world, उद्विग्नम् distressed, अभवत् became, भूमिश्च and the earth, ध्वस्तसङ्काशा as though shattered, निःस्नेहा without moisture, शुष्ककानना its woods withered
entries.86.5: ते those, सर्वे all, ह्रदाश्च the pools, तथा likewise, सरितः the rivers, निःस्रोतसः च and were without current, अनावृष्टिकृतः caused by drought, सत्त्वानाम् of creatures, सङ्क्षोभश्चैव and the affliction, अभवत् arose
entries.86.6: अस्मिन् when this, लोके world, क्षीयमाणे तु was wasting away, सम्भ्रान्तमनसः their minds in confusion, सुराः the gods, पूर्वम् formerly, विष्णुना by Vishnu, यत् which, उक्तम् was spoken of, तम् that, यज्ञम् sacrifice, समुपानयन् set on foot
entries.86.7: ततः then, सर्वे all, सुरगणाः the hosts of gods, सोपाध्यायाः with their teachers, सहर्षिभिः along with the sages, यत्र where, इन्द्रः Indra, भयमोहितः bewildered by fear, तम् that, देशम् place, समुपाजग्मुः came to
entries.86.8: ते they, ब्रह्महत्यया by the slaying of a brahmin, आवृतम् beset, सहस्राक्षम् the thousand-eyed one, दृष्ट्वा तु having seen, देवेशम् the lord of the gods, तम् him, पुरस्कृत्य having set foremost, अश्वमेधम् the horse-sacrifice, उपाक्रमन् began
entries.86.9: नरेश्वर O lord of men, ततः then, महात्मनः of the great-souled, महेन्द्रस्य Mahendra, सुमहान् exceedingly great, अश्वमेधः horse-sacrifice, ब्रह्महत्ययाः of the slaying of a brahmin, पावनार्थम् for the sake of purification, ववृधे went forward
entries.86.10: ततः then, यज्ञे when the sacrifice, समाप्ते तु was completed, ब्रह्महत्या the slaying of a brahmin, महात्मनः the great-souled one, अभिगम्य having approached, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, मे my, स्थानम् abode, क्व where, विधास्यथ will you appoint
entries.86.11: तदा then, तुष्टाः well pleased, प्रीतिसमन्विताः filled with gladness, ते those, देवाः gods, ताम् to her, ऊचुः said, दुरासदे O unapproachable one, आत्मना एव by your own self, आत्मानम् yourself, चतुर्धा fourfold, विभज divide
entries.86.12: महात्मनाम् of the great-souled ones, देवानाम् of the gods, भाषितम् the speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, दुर्वसा the hard to dwell with, ब्रह्महत्या the slaying of a brahmin, सन्निधौ in their presence, अन्यत्र elsewhere, स्थानम् an abode, वरयामास chose
entries.86.13: दर्पघ्नी destroyer of pride, कामवारिणी that stays desire, एकेन by one, अंशेन portion, चतुरः four, वार्षिकान् of the rains, मासान् months, पूर्णोदासु in their full waters, नदीषु वै in the rivers indeed, वत्स्यामि I shall dwell
entries.86.14: अहम् I, एकेन by one, अंशेन portion, सर्वदा always, सर्वकालम् at all times, भूम्याम् upon the earth, वसिष्यामि shall dwell, न सन्देहः there is no doubt, सत्येन in truth, वः to you, एतत् this, ब्रवीमि I declare
entries.86.15: मे my, यः which, अयम् this, तृतीयः third, अंशः portion, दर्पघातिनी destroying pride, दर्पपूर्णासु full of pride, यौवनशालिषु in the bloom of youth, स्त्रीषु in women, त्रिरात्रम् for three nights, वशिष्ये I shall abide
entries.86.16: सुरर्षभाः O bulls among the gods, ये तु and whoever, मृषापूर्वम् falsely, अदूषकान् the guiltless, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, हन्तारः are slayers of, तान् them, चतुर्थेन by the fourth, भागेन portion, संश्रयिष्ये I shall resort to
entries.86.17: ततः then, देवाः the gods, ताम् to her, प्रत्यूचुः replied, दुर्वसे O hard to dwell with, यथा as, वदसि you say, तथा so, तत् that, सर्वम् all, भवतु let it be, यत् whatever, ईप्सितम् is desired, साधयस्व accomplish
entries.86.18: ततः then, प्रीत्या with joy, अन्विताः filled, देवाः the gods, सहस्राक्षम् the thousand-eyed one, ववन्दिरे saluted, सः he, वासवः Vasava, विज्वरः free of affliction, पूतात्मा च and purified in self, समपद्यत became
entries.86.19: सहस्राक्षे when the thousand-eyed one, प्रतिष्ठिते was restored, सर्वम् the whole, जगत् च world, प्रशान्तम् grew calm, तदा then, शक्रः Shakra, अद्भुतसङ्काशम् wondrous to behold, यज्ञं च and the sacrifice, अभ्यपूजयत् honoured
entries.86.20: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, पार्थिव O king, सुमहाभाग O greatly blessed one, अश्वमेधस्य of the horse-sacrifice, प्रसादः the grace, ईदृशः हि is indeed such, हयमेधेन with the horse-sacrifice, यजस्व perform sacrifice
entries.86.21: महात्मा the great-souled, इन्द्रसमानविक्रमौजाः equal to Indra in valour and might, नृपतिः king, अतीव exceedingly, मनोहरम् delightful, उत्तमम् most excellent, इति thus spoken, लक्ष्मणवाक्यम् the speech of Lakshmana, निशमय्य having heard, हृष्टचेताः glad at heart, परितोषम् satisfaction, अवाप obtained
entries.87.1: वाक्यविशारदः skilled in speech, महातेजाः of great splendour, राघवः Raghava, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, उक्तम् spoken, तत् that, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रहसन् smiling, वचः these words, प्रत्युवाच replied
entries.87.2: नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, यथा as, वदसि you say, एवम् एव just so it is, वृत्रघातम् the slaying of Vritra, अशेषेण in full, यत् what, वाजिमेधफलं च and the fruit of the horse-sacrifice
entries.87.3: सौम्य O gentle one, पुरा of old, प्रजापतेः of Prajapati, कर्दमस्य Kardama, श्रीमान् the illustrious, महाशयाः of noble mind, इलो नाम Ila by name, पुत्रः son, बाह्लीश्वरः lord of Bahli, श्रूयते हि is indeed heard of
entries.87.4: नरव्याघ्र O tiger among men, सुधार्मिकः most righteous, सः that, राजा king, सर्वाम् the whole, पृथिवीम् earth, वशे under sway, कृत्वा having brought, राज्यं चैव and the kingdom too, पुत्रवत् as a son, पर्यपालयत् cherished
entries.87.5: परमोदारैः most noble, सुरैश्च by the gods, महाधनैः of great wealth, दैतेयैश्च and by the daityas, नागराक्षसगन्धर्वैः by nagas and rakshasas and gandharvas, सुमहात्मभिः exceedingly great-souled, यक्षैश्च and by yakshas
entries.87.6: सौम्य O gentle one, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, भयार्तैः afflicted with fear, नित्यशः ever, पूज्यते he was honoured, सरोषस्य of him when enraged, महात्मनः the great-souled, त्रयः the three, लोकाः worlds, अबिभ्यन् च and were afraid
entries.87.7: महायशाः of great renown, बाह्लीकेशः lord of the Bahlikas, सः that, राजा king, तादृशः हि was indeed such, धर्मे in dharma, वीर्ये च and in valour, निष्ठितः established, बुद्ध्या च and in understanding, परमोदारः most noble, आसीत् he was
entries.87.8: सः he, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, मनोरमे in the delightful, चैत्रे Chaitra, मासि month, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with his servants and troops and mounts, रुचिरे in a lovely, वने wood, मृगयाम् the chase, प्रचक्रे undertook
entries.87.9: नृपः the king, अरण्ये in the wilderness, मृगान् deer, शतसहस्रशः by hundreds of thousands, प्रजघ्ने slew, हत्वा एव even by slaying, महात्मनः of the great-souled, तस्य his, राज्ञः king's, तृप्तिः satiety, न अभूत् च came not
entries.87.10: महात्मना by the great-souled one, नानामृगाणाम् of deer of every kind, अयुतम् a myriad, वध्यमानम् being slain, यत्र where, माहासेनः the great Skanda, जातः was born, तम् that, देशम् region, उपचक्रमे he approached
entries.87.11: तस्मिन् in that, प्रदेशे region, देवेश O lord of the gods, दुर्धर्षः the unassailable, हरः Hara, सर्वैः with all, अनुचरैः सह his attendants, शैलराजसुताम् the daughter of the lord of mountains, रमयामास delighted
entries.87.12: उमेशः the lord of Uma, गोपतिध्वजः whose banner bears the bull, आत्मानम् himself, स्त्रीरूपम् into a woman's form, कृत्वा having made, देव्याः of the goddess, प्रियचिकीर्षुः wishing to do what pleased, तस्मिन् in that, पर्वतनिर्झरे mountain glen, संस् abiding
entries.87.13: तत्र there, वनोद्देशे in that tract of wood, ये सत्त्वाः whatever creatures, पुरुषवादिनः bearing masculine names, पुरुषनामानः of masculine name, वृक्षाः the trees, ते they, तदा then, स्त्रीजनाः womankind, अभवन् became
entries.87.14: यत् किञ्चन whatsoever there was, तत् that, सर्वम् all, नारीसञ्ज्ञम् bearing a woman's name, बभूव ह did indeed become, एतस्मिन् अन्तरे in this interval, कर्दमात्मजः son of Kardama, सः that, इलः Ila, राजा king, मृगसहस्राणि thousands of deer, निघ्नन् slaying, तम् that, देशम् region, उपचक्रमे approached
entries.87.15: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, सः he, सव्यालमृगपक्षकम् with its serpents and beasts and birds, सर्वम् all, स्त्रीकृतम् turned to female, सानुगम् with his followers, आत्मनं चैव and himself too, स्त्रीकृतम् turned to female, दृष्ट्वा having seen
entries.87.16: आत्मानम् himself, तथागतम् brought to such a state, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तस्य his, महत् great, दुःखम् sorrow, आसीत् च arose, उमापतेः of the lord of Uma, तत् that, कर्म deed, ज्ञात्वा and having known, त्रासम् terror, उपागमत् came to
entries.87.17: ततः then, राजा the king, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with his servants and troops and mounts, महात्मानम् the great-souled, शितिकण्ठम् the blue-throated, कपर्दिनम् the matted-haired, देवम् god, शरणम् for refuge, जगाम went to
entries.87.18: ततः then, वरदः the giver of boons, महेश्वरः Maheshvara, देव्या सह along with the goddess, प्रहस्य having laughed, स्वयम् himself, वरदः granter of boons, प्रजापतिसुतम् to the son of Prajapati, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke
entries.87.19: राजर्षे O royal sage, कार्दमेय O son of Kardama, महाबल O you of great strength, सुव्रत O you of good vows, उत्तिष्ठ उत्तिष्ठ rise up and rise, सौम्य O gentle one, पुरुषत्वम् manhood, ऋते save only, वरम् a boon, वरय choose
entries.87.20: ततः then, महात्मना by the great-souled one, प्रत्याख्यातः refused, दुःखार्तः stricken with sorrow, सः that, राजा king, स्त्रीभूतः turned woman, सुरोत्तमात् from the best of the gods, अन्यम् another, वरम् boon, न च जग्राह took not
entries.87.21: ततः then, नृपः the king, महता with great, शोकेन grief, शैलराजसुताम् the daughter of the lord of mountains, उमाम् Uma, देवीम् the goddess, सर्वेण एव with the whole, अन्तरात्मना inmost self, प्रणिपत्य हि having indeed bowed down
entries.87.22: भामिनी O radiant lady, अमोघदर्शने O you whose sight is never in vain, देवी O goddess, वराणाम् of boons, ईशे you are the mistress, लोकानाम् of the worlds, वरदे O granter of boons, असि you are, सौम्येन with a kindly, चक्षुषा eye, भज look upon me
entries.87.23: रुद्रस्य of Rudra, संमता the honoured consort, देवी the goddess, हरसन्निधौ in the presence of Hara, तस्य his, राजर्षेः the royal sage's, हृद्गतम् what was in his heart, विज्ञाय having perceived, शुभम् an auspicious, वाक्यम् word, प्रत्युवाच replied
entries.87.24: अर्धस्य of the one half, देवः the god, वरदः is the giver of boons, तव your, वरार्धस्य of the other half of the boon, अहम् हि I indeed, तस्मात् therefore, स्त्रीपुंसोः of woman and of man, यावत् as much as, इच्छसि you desire, अर्धम् the half, त्वम् you, गृहाण take
entries.87.25: देव्याः of the goddess, तत् that, अद्भुततरम् most wondrous, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, वरम् boon, श्रुत्वा having heard, सम्प्रहृष्टमनाः glad at heart, भूत्वा having become, राजा the king, अथ then, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.87.26: देवि O goddess, यदि if, मे toward me, प्रसन्ना you are gracious, भुवि on earth, रूपेण in beauty, अप्रतिमा unmatched, मासम् for a month, स्त्रीत्वम् womanhood, उपासित्वा having dwelt in, मासम् for a month, पुनः again, पुरुषः a man, स्याम् may I be
entries.87.27: सुरुचिरानना of most beautiful face, देवी the goddess, तस्य his, ईप्सितम् desire, विज्ञाय having perceived, शुभम् an auspicious, वाक्यम् word, प्रत्युवाच replied, एवम् एव even so, भविष्यति it shall be
entries.87.28: राजन् O king, त्वम् you, पुरुषभूतः being a man, स्त्रीभावम् the woman's state, न स्मरिष्यसि shall not remember, स्त्रीभूतश्च and being a woman, परम् the next, मासम् month, पौरुषम् your manhood, न स्मरिष्यसि shall not remember
entries.87.29: एवम् thus, सः that, कार्दमिः son of Kardama, राजा king, मासम् for a month, पुरुषः a man, भूत्वा having been, अथ then, इला Ila, त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी loveliest in the three worlds, नारी a woman, मासम् एकम् for one month, अभवत् became
entries.88.1: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भरतश्चैव and Bharata, रामेण by Rama, समुदीरिताम् uttered, इलसम्बद्धाम् concerning Ila, ताम् that, कथाम् tale, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमविस्मितौ were greatly amazed
entries.88.2: तौ those two, प्राञ्जली with joined palms, भूत्वा having become, रामम् to Rama, तस्य his, महात्मनः of the great-souled, राज्ञः king, तस्य that, भावस्य state's, विस्तरम् the full account, तदा then, पुनः again, पप्रच्छतुः asked
entries.88.3: दुर्गतिः fallen on evil days, सः that, राजा king, स्त्रीभूतः turned woman, कथम् how, वर्तयामास did he live, यदा when, सः he, पुरुषः a man, भूतः became, असौ he, काम् what, वृत्तिम् manner of life, वर्तयति does he lead
entries.88.4: काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, कौतूहलसमन्वितम् filled with curiosity, तयोः their, तत् that, भाषितम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, तस्य of that, राज्ञः king, यथागतम् just as it had happened, कथयामास related
entries.88.5: तम् एव that very, प्रथमम् first, मासम् month, स्त्रीभूता turned woman, लोकसुन्दरी loveliest in the world, ये च and those who, पूर्वपदानुगाः were formerly her followers, ताभिः by those, स्त्रीभिः women, परिवृता surrounded
entries.88.6: लोकसुन्दरी the loveliest in the world, पद्मदलेक्षणा her eyes like lotus petals, द्रुमगुल्मलताकीर्णम् thick with trees and bushes and creepers, तत् that, काननम् wood, आशु swiftly, विगाह्य having entered, पद्भ्याम् on foot, विजह्रे roamed
entries.88.7: सा she, सर्वाणि all, वाहनानि च and her mounts, समन्ततः on every side, त्यक्त्वा वै having indeed abandoned, तस्मिन् in that, पर्वताभोगविवरे hollow within the mountain's expanse, तदा then, इला Ila, रेमे took delight
entries.88.8: अथ then, तस्मिन् in that, वनोद्देशे tract of wood, पर्वतस्य of the mountain, अविदूरतः not far from, सुरुचिरप्रख्यम् of most beautiful aspect, नानापक्षिगणैः with flocks of birds of every kind, युतम् filled, सरः a lake
entries.88.9: सा तु and she, इला Ila, तस्मिन् in it, तदा then, स्वेन with his own, वपुषा form, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, उदितम् risen, पूर्णसोमम् इव like the full moon, सोमसुतम् son of Soma, बुधम् Budha, ददर्श saw
entries.88.10: अम्भोमध्ये in the midst of the waters, तीव्रम् fierce, तपः austerity, तपन्तं च and practising, दुरासदम् hard to approach, यशस्करम् conferring fame, कामकरम् fulfilling desire, कारुण्ये in compassion, पर्यवस्थितम् established
entries.88.11: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, विस्मिता filled with wonder, सा she, स्त्रीभूतैः turned to women, सहगैः accompanying her, पूर्वपुरुषैः with her former men, तम् that, सर्वम् whole, जलाशयम् sheet of water, क्षोभयामास set astir
entries.88.12: बुधः तु and Budha, ताम् her, समीक्ष्य एव as soon as he beheld, कामबाणवशम् into the power of the arrows of Kama, गतः fell, तदा then, आत्मानम् himself, न उपलेभे did not find, तदा then, अम्भसि in the water, सञ्चचाल he stirred
entries.88.13: त्रैलोक्याभ्यधिकाम् surpassing the three worlds, शुभाम् fair, इलाम् Ila, निरीक्षमाणः तु as he gazed upon, इयम् this one, का नु who can she be, देवताधिका surpassing the gods, चिन्ताम् anxiety, समभ्यतिक्रामत् he passed into
entries.88.14: अनेन by this, रूपेण beauty, शोभिता graced, काचित् any such, मया by me, न देवीषु neither among goddesses, न नागीषु nor among naga women, न असुरीषु nor among asura women, अप्सरःसु च nor among apsaras, दृष्टपूर्वा has been seen before
entries.88.15: यदि if, न अन्यपरिग्रहः if she be not another's wedded wife, इयम् she, मम to me, सदृशी a fitting match, भवेत् would be, इति thus, बुद्धिम् his mind, समास्थाय having settled, जलात् from the water, कूलम् to the bank, उपागमत् came
entries.88.16: ततः then, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, आश्रमम् the hermitage, समुपागम्य having reached, ताः those, प्रमदोत्तमाः most excellent women, शब्दापयत summoned, ताश्चैनम् and they him, ववन्दिरे saluted
entries.88.17: धर्मात्मा the righteous one, सः he, ताः them, पप्रच्छ asked, एषा this, लोकसुन्दरी loveliest in the world, कस्य whose is she, किमर्थम् for what purpose, आगता चैव and has she come, सर्वम् everything, आख्यात tell, मा चिरम् delay not
entries.88.18: मधुराक्षरम् of sweet syllables, मधुरम् sweet, शुभम् auspicious, तस्य his, तत् that, वाक्यम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, ताः those, सर्वाः all, स्त्रियश्च women, मधुरया in a sweet, गिरा voice, ऊचुः said
entries.88.19: एषा this, सुश्रोणी fair-hipped one, सदा ever, अस्माकम् over us, प्रभुत्वे in lordship, वर्तते stands, असौ she, अपतिः without a husband, काननान्तेषु in the reaches of the wood, अस्माभिः सह along with us, चरति moves about
entries.88.20: सः that, द्विजः brahmin, तासाम् their, स्त्रीणाम् women's, अव्यक्तपदम् of indistinct words, तत् that, वाक्यम् speech, निशम्य च having heard, पुण्याम् the holy, आवर्तनीम् recollective, विद्याम् lore, आवर्तयत brought to mind
entries.88.21: सः he, तस्य of that, राज्ञः king, यथागतम् just as it had happened, सकलम् the whole, अर्थम् matter, विदित्वा having learnt, मुनिपुङ्गवः the bull among sages, ताः those, सर्वाः all, स्त्रियः एव च and the women, बभाषे addressed
entries.88.22: अत्र here, किम्पुरुषीः as kimpurusha women, भूत्वा having become, शैलरोधसि on the mountain slope, वत्स्यथ you shall dwell, अस्मिन् on this, गिरौ mountain, आवासः तु a dwelling indeed, शीघ्रम् एव right quickly, विधीयताम् let it be made
entries.88.23: सर्वाः all of you, मूलपत्रफलैः on roots and leaves and fruits, नित्यदा ever, वर्तयिष्यथ shall subsist, स्त्रियः O women, किम्पुरुषान् नाम kimpurushas by name, भर्तॄन् as husbands, समुपलप्स्यथ you shall obtain
entries.88.24: ताः they, सोमपुत्रस्य of the son of Soma, वाचम् the word, श्रुत्वा having heard, किम्पुरुषीकृताः turned into kimpurusha women, ताः those, वध्वः brides, तदा then, बहुलाः many, शैलम् the mountain, उपासाञ्चक्रिरे took to dwelling upon
entries.89.1: तदा then, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भरतः Bharata, किम्पुरुषोत्पत्तिम् the origin of the kimpurushas, श्रुत्वा having heard, उभौ both, जनेश्वरम् the lord of men, रामम् to Rama, आश्चर्यम् a marvel, इति thus, चाब्रूताम् and said
entries.89.2: अथ then, महायशाः of great renown, धर्मात्मा the righteous, रामः Rama, प्रजापतिसुतस्य वै of the son of Prajapati indeed, एताम् this, कथाम् tale, भूयः एव once again, कथयामास related
entries.89.3: ऋषिसत्तमः the best of sages, सर्वाः all, ताः those, किन्नरीः kinnara women, विद्रुताः scattered, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रूपसम्पन्नाम् endowed with beauty, ताम् that, स्त्रियम् woman, प्रहसन् इव as though smiling, उवाच addressed
entries.89.4: सुरुचिरानने O most lovely of face, वरारोहे O fair one, अहम् I, सोमस्य of Soma, सुदयितः the dearly beloved, सुतः son, भक्त्या with devotion, स्निग्धेन with a tender, चक्षुषा eye, माम् me, भजस्व take to yourself
entries.89.5: शून्ये in that lonely place, स्वजनवर्जिते empty of her own folk, तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, इला Ila, सुरुचिरप्रख्यम् of most beautiful aspect, महाग्रहम् the great luminary, प्रत्युवाच replied to
entries.89.6: सौम्य O gentle one, सोमसुत O son of Soma, अहम् I, कामचरी go where I will, तव your, वशवर्तिनी subject to your will, अस्मि am, माम् me, प्रशाधि command, यथा as, इच्छसि you desire, तथा so, कुरु do
entries.89.7: तस्याः her, तत् that, अद्भुतप्रख्यम् wondrous-seeming word, श्रुत्वा having heard, हर्षम् joy, उपागतः came to, चन्द्रमसः of the moon, सुतः the son, सः that, कामी वै lover indeed, तया सह along with her, रेमे took his delight
entries.89.8: बुधस्य of Budha, माधवः of Madhava, मासः the month, ताम् that, रुचिराननाम् of lovely face, इलाम् Ila, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, रमयतः as he delighted, तस्य his, कामिनः the lover's, क्षणवत् as but a moment, गतः passed
entries.89.9: अथ then, मासे when the month, सम्पूर्णे was full, पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननः his face like the full moon, श्रीमान् the illustrious, प्रजापतिसुतः son of Prajapati, शयने upon his couch, प्रत्यबुध्यत awoke
entries.89.10: सः he, तत्र there, सलिलाशये in the sheet of water, तपन्तम् practising austerity, ऊर्ध्वबाहुम् his arms raised, निरालम्बम् without support, सोमजम् the son of Soma, अपश्यत् saw, राजा the king, तम् him, प्रत्यभाषत addressed
entries.89.11: भगवन् O venerable one, अहम् I, सहानुगः with my followers, दुर्गम् inaccessible, पर्वतम् mountain, प्रविष्टः अस्मि have entered, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, न च पश्यामि I do not see, मे my, ते those, मामकाः own men, क्व नु where indeed, गताः have they gone
entries.89.12: नष्टसञ्ज्ञस्य of him whose memory was lost, तस्य his, राजर्षेः the royal sage's, भाषितम् speech, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, परया with the highest, गिरा voice, सान्त्वयन् comforting him, शुभम् an auspicious, वाक्यम् word, प्रत्युवाच replied
entries.89.13: महता by a great, अश्मवर्षेण rain of stones, ते your, भृत्याः servants, विनिपातिताः were struck down, त्वं च and you, वातवर्षभयार्दितः afflicted by fear of the wind and rain, आश्रमपदे in the hermitage, सुप्तः slept
entries.89.14: वीर O hero, ते to you, भद्रम् good fortune, निर्भयः free of fear, विगतज्वरः free of care, समाश्वसिहि take heart, फलमूलाशनः eating fruit and root, इह here, यथासुखम् at your ease, निवस dwell
entries.89.15: महामतिः of great mind, सः that, राजा king, तेन by that, वाक्येन speech, प्रत्याश्वस्तः comforted, भृत्यक्षयात् by the loss of his servants, भृशम् deeply, दीनः grieved, ततः then, वाक्यम् these words, प्रत्युवाच replied
entries.89.16: ब्रह्मन् O brahmin, अहम् I, स्वकम् my own, राज्यम् kingdom, त्यक्ष्यामि shall forsake, भृत्यैः of my servants, विनाकृतः deprived, अहम् I, क्षणम् for a moment, न वर्तयेयम् could not live on, समनुज्ञातुम् to give me leave, अर्हसि you ought
entries.89.17: ब्रह्मन् O brahmin, महायशाः of great renown, धर्मपरः devoted to dharma, ज्येष्ठः eldest, मम my, सुतः son, शशबिन्दुः इति as Shashabindu, ख्यातः is known, सः he, मे my, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रपत्स्यते shall obtain
entries.89.18: महातेजः O you of great splendour, सुखान्वितान् who lived in happiness, भृत्यदारान् the wives of my servants, हित्वा having abandoned, अहम् I, किञ्चित् any, अशुभम् inauspicious, वचः अपि word even, प्रतिवक्तुम् to utter in reply, न हि शक्ष्यामि shall not indeed be able
entries.89.19: राजेन्द्रे when the lord of kings, तथा so, ब्रुवति spoke, बुधः Budha, परमम् most, अद्भुतम् wondrous, सान्त्वपूर्वम् with conciliatory words, अथ then, उवाच said, इह here, ते your, वासः dwelling, रोचताम् let it please you
entries.89.20: कार्दमेय O son of Kardama, महाबल O you of great strength, त्वया by you, सन्तापः grief, न कार्यः is not to be made, इह here, संवत्सरोषितस्य of you having dwelt a year, ते your, हितम् good, कारयिष्यामि I shall bring about
entries.89.21: अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of untiring deeds, बुधस्य of Budha, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, ब्रह्मवादिना by the expounder of the Veda, यत् what, उक्तम् was said, वासाय for dwelling there, बुद्धिम् his mind, विदधे set
entries.89.22: तदा then, सः he, मासम् for a month, स्त्री a woman, भूत्वा having become, शुदा with delight, अनिशम् unceasingly, रमयति gave delight, मासम् for a month, पुरुषभावेन in the state of a man, सः he, धर्मबुद्धिम् his mind upon dharma, चकार set
entries.89.23: ततः then, नवमे in the ninth, मासि month, सुश्रोणी the fair-hipped one, सा that, इला Ila, सोमसुतात् by the son of Soma, ऊर्जितम् mighty, पुरूरवसम् Pururavas, सुतम् as son, जनयामास bore
entries.89.24: सुश्रोणी the fair-hipped one, इला Ila, जातमात्रम् तु as soon as he was born, बुधस्य of Budha, समवर्णभम् of like radiance, महाबलम् mighty, पुत्रम् the son, पितुः of the father, हस्ते in the hand, न्यवेशयत् placed
entries.89.25: आत्मवान् self-possessed, बुधः तु and Budha, पुरुषीभूतम् him become a man, संवत्सरान्तरम् for a full year, धर्मयुक्ताभिः charged with dharma, कथाभिः with tales, सः वै he indeed, रमयामास delighted
entries.90.1: रामे when Rama, तथा so, उक्तवति तु had spoken, तस्य his, तत् that, अद्भुतम् wondrous, जन्म birth, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, महायशाः of great renown, भरतश्च and Bharata, भूयः again, उवाच spoke
entries.90.2: नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, सा that, इला Ila, सोमपुत्रस्य of the son of Soma, संवत्सरम् for a year, अथ then, उषिता having dwelt, किम् what, अकरोत् did she do, तत् that, त्वम् you, शंसितुम् to declare, अर्हसि you ought
entries.90.3: रामः Rama, परिपृच्छतोः of the two as they questioned, तयोः their, तद्वाक्यमाधुर्यम् sweetness of speech, निशम्य having heard, प्रजापतिसुते concerning the son of Prajapati, इमाम् this, कथाम् tale, पुनः again, उवाच spoke
entries.90.4: शूरे when the hero, पुरुषत्वम् manhood, गते had come to, परमबुद्धिमान् of supreme wisdom, महायशाः of great renown, बुधः Budha, परमोदारम् most noble, संवर्तम् Samvarta, आजुहाव summoned
entries.90.5: च्यवनम् Chyavana, भृगुपुत्रं च and the son of Bhrigu, मुनिम् the sage, अरिष्टनेमिनम् Arishtanemi, प्रमोदनम् Pramodana, मोदकरम् Modakara, ततः then, दुर्वाससम् Durvasas, मुनिम् the sage
entries.90.6: वाक्यज्ञः knowing how to speak, तत्त्वदर्शनः a seer of truth, एतान् these, सर्वान् all, समानीय having assembled, धैर्येण in firmness, सुसमाहितान् well established, सर्वान् all, सुहृदः his friends, उवाच addressed
entries.90.7: अयम् this, महाबाहुः mighty-armed, राजा king, कर्दमस्य of Kardama, सुतः son, इलः Ila, एनम् him, यथाभूतम् as he truly is, जानीत know, अत्र herein, श्रेयः हि what is best indeed, विधीयताम् let it be ordained
entries.90.8: तेषाम् as they, संवदताम् एव were yet conversing, महातेजाः of great splendour, कर्दमः तु and Kardama, महात्मभिः with the great-souled, द्विजैः सह along with the twice-born, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् came to
entries.90.9: पुलस्त्यश्च and Pulastya, क्रतुश्चैव and Kratu, तथैव च and likewise, वषट्कारः Vashatkara, महातेजाः of great splendour, ओङ्कारश्च and Omkara, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागमत् came to
entries.90.10: ते those, सर्वे all, परस्परसमागमे at meeting one another, हृष्टमनसः glad at heart, बाल्हिपतेः of the lord of Bahli, हितैषिणः wishing his welfare, पृथक् severally, वाक्यानि their words, अथ then, अब्रुवन् spoke
entries.90.11: कर्दमः तु and Kardama, सुतार्थम् for his son's sake, परमम् most, हितम् beneficial, वाक्यम् a word, अब्रवीत् spoke, द्विजाः O twice-born ones, मद्वाक्यम् my word, शृणुत hear, यत् what, पार्थिवस्य हि for the king indeed, श्रेयः is best
entries.90.12: वृषभध्वजम् him whose banner bears the bull, अन्तरा apart from, अन्यम् another, भैषज्यम् remedy, न पश्यामि I see not, अश्वमेधात् than the horse-sacrifice, परः higher, यज्ञः न there is no rite, महात्मनः to the great-souled one, प्रियश्चैव and it is dear, तस्मात् therefore, सर्वे all of us, पार्थिवार्थे for the king's sake, दुरासदम् that hard-won rite, यजामहे let us offer
entries.90.13: कर्दमेन by Kardama, एवम् thus, उक्ताः तु addressed, सर्वे एव all, द्विजर्षभाः bulls among the twice-born, रुद्रस्य of Rudra, आराधनं प्रति toward the propitiation, तम् that, यज्ञम् sacrifice, रोचयन्ति स्म approved
entries.90.14: राजर्षेः of the royal sage, संवर्तस्य तु and of Samvarta, शिष्यः the pupil, पुरपुरञ्जयः conqueror of the cities of foes, मरुत्त इति as Marutta, विख्यातः renowned, तम् that, यज्ञम् sacrifice, समुपाहरत् set on foot
entries.90.15: ततः then, बुधाश्रमसमीपतः near the hermitage of Budha, महान् a great, यज्ञः sacrifice, आसीत् took place, महायशाः of great renown, रुद्रश्च and Rudra, परमम् the utmost, तोषम् satisfaction, आजगाम came to
entries.90.16: अथ then, यज्ञे when the sacrifice, समाप्ते तु was completed, परमया with the utmost, मुदा joy, प्रीतः pleased, उमापतिः the lord of Uma, इलसन्निधौ in the presence of Ila, सर्वान् all, द्विजान् the twice-born, उवाच addressed
entries.90.17: द्विजसत्तमाः O best of the twice-born, हयमेधेन by the horse-sacrifice, भक्त्या च and by your devotion, प्रीतः अस्मि I am pleased, अस्य for this, बाह्लिपतेश्चैव lord of Bahli too, किम् what, प्रियम् dear, शुभम् auspicious thing, करोमि shall I do
entries.90.18: देवेशे when the lord of the gods, तथा so, वदति spoke, ते those, द्विजाः the twice-born, सुसमाहिताः well composed, देवेशम् the lord of the gods, प्रसादयन्ति besought, यथा so that, इला Ila, पुरुषः a man, स्यात् might be
entries.90.19: ततः then, प्रीतः pleased, सुमहातेजाः of exceedingly great splendour, महादेवः Mahadeva, इलायै to Ila, पुनः again, पुरुषत्वम् manhood, ददौ gave, दत्त्वा च and having given it, अन्तरधीयत vanished
entries.90.20: हयमेधे when the horse-sacrifice, निवृत्ते was concluded, हरः Hara, अदर्शनम् out of sight, गतश्च and had gone, दीर्घदर्शिनः of far sight, सर्वे all, द्विजाः the twice-born, यथागतम् as they had come, हि indeed, अगच्छन् went
entries.90.21: राजा तु and the king, बाह्लिम् Bahli, उत्सृज्य having quitted, मध्यदेशे in the middle country, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, यशस्करम् fame-bringing, प्रतिष्ठानम् Pratishthana, पुरम् the city, निवेशयामास हि did indeed found
entries.90.22: पुरपुरञ्जयः conqueror of the cities of foes, राजर्षिः the royal sage, शशबिन्दुश्च and Shashabindu, बाह्लिम् Bahli, प्रजापतिसुतः son of Prajapati, बली the mighty, इलः Ila, राजा king, प्रतिष्ठाने at Pratishthana
entries.90.23: सः he, इलः Ila, काले in due time, अनुत्तमम् the unsurpassed, ब्राह्मम् of Brahma, लोकम् world, प्राप्तवान् attained, ऐलः the son of Ila, पुरूरवाः Pururavas, राजा king, प्रतिष्ठानम् Pratishthana, अवाप्तवान् obtained
entries.90.24: पुरुषर्षभौ O you two bulls among men, अश्वमेधस्य of the horse-sacrifice, प्रभावः the power, ईदृशः हि is indeed such, स्त्रीभूतः he who had become a woman, पौरुषम् manhood, लेभे obtained, यत् what, अन्यत् अपि even else, दुर्लभम् च and is hard to win
